notes.title: Freezing or locking during gameplay on Steam
notes.content:
While playing STAR WARS™: The Force Unleashed II on Steam with a Windows 10 system, some users have reported issues with freezing or locking when the Game Bar overlay appears.

 

This issue can be resolved by disabling the Game Bar setting in Windows:

* Right-click the Start menu and select "Settings"

* From Settings, select "Gaming"

* Under Gaming, select "Game bar"

* In Game bar settings, click the switch OFF under "Record game clips, screenshots..."
